files.* (and to a lesser extent context.*/arch.*) get used as scratch space, not seeds: agent rewrites the SAME key 4-7× per session with tiny deltas (worst observed: 7× in one session) — the mechanism behind the ~10:1 write:read skew on files.*. Disciplined stores cap at 2× — the pattern is agent-discipline-specific, not store-specific.

GUARD SHIPPED v1.14 (#101, PR #108): in-memory per-session-per-key write timestamps; the 3rd+ write within a 30-min sliding window adds a "warning:" line to the reverie_set response (count + time-since-first + pointer to conventions.seedDensity) and writeAmpWarning/writeAmpCount fields to telemetry/audit rows. MCP-only — CLI sessions are per-process with no session to attach to (WS3 #119 territory).
